Polish for the header, compact mode and the plugin browser, plus themes.

**New**
- Themes: MENU → Theme → Dark, Ash (soft charcoal) or Light. Accent, meters and cover art keep their colours.
- Volume goes up to +6 dB. A small mark on the fader shows 0 dB and the handle catches there; above it the line turns orange. ↑ stops at 0 dB once before going further.

**Fixed and changed**
- Compact mode no longer jumps: the plugins go at once instead of a plugin row coming back after the window shrinks, and the window can be lower than its usual minimum. Quitting in compact mode starts at full height next time.
- Track details: title, artist, file details and time each on their own line, no dot separators and no "…". When it gets narrow, whole items drop from the end. Two font sizes only (title, everything else); the block scales with the header height.
- The volume handle is slimmer and shorter.
- The waveform starts and ends exactly over the outer edges of the plugin row.
- Add plugin: the lines above and below the waveform no longer show through the overlay, and the lower cards are no longer faded out.
- Transport keeps 60 fps when another app has the focus (30 fps only when you turn smooth animations off).
